example.title: Visitor Center, Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge (2007)

brief: A 2007 wildlife-refuge visitor centre on a marsh pond: a lodge-like building with a steep green metal gabled roof, a big glazed gable window, stone piers and timber posts, geese on the water in front. One photo. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
